the_call_chain.set_blocksize: takes bdevsw[...].d_psize(dev) and stores it in v_specsize
the_call_chain.the_trap: a block node therefore needs v_specsize <= PAGE_SIZE. xnusys_size returns a block COUNT (356352 for this window), which exceeds PAGE_SIZE, so the VBLK path answers EINVAL before any request reaches the driver. The existing /dev/xnusys never hit this because nothing ever read() it as a raw block device -- the file system mounts it and reads through the strategy.

the_four_flips.why: a window block has no measured reference, so twoblock_reference failed, and the failure return skips the lease restore
